const CATALOG_TEXT = PRODUCTS.map(p=>`- ${p.name} (${p.cat}): "${p.tagline}" | Power: ${p.power}`).join("\n");
const CATS = ["Todos","Colares","Pulseiras","Anéis","Brincos"];

const SITS = [
  {id:"reuniao",  l:"Reunião importante",        s:"Trabalho · Apresentação · Negociação"},
  {id:"entrevista",l:"Entrevista de emprego",     s:"Primeira impressão · Confiança · Autoridade"},

  {id:"poder",    l:"Momento de poder pessoal",   s:"Quando precisas de ser absolutamente imparável"},

const f = "'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif";
const sans = "'Jost', sans-serif";
const C = {cream:"#faf5ee",dark:"#1a0f06",gold:"#b8892a",goldL:"#e8c060",muted:"#9a7a55",border:"#e8ddd0",warm:"#f2ebe0"};

const CartIcon = ({size=20,color="#faf5ee"}) => (
  <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
    <path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V6l-3-4z"/>
    <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/>
    <path d="M16 10a4 4 0 01-8 0"/>
  </svg>
);

const JewelArt = ({cat,size=72}) => {
  const g = "#b8892a";
  if (cat==="Colares") return <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 80 80"><circle cx="40" cy="40" r="28" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" opacity=".6"/><circle cx="40" cy="40" r="18" stroke={g} strokeWidth=".6" fill="none" opacity=".3"/><circle cx="40" cy="12" r="4" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1" fill="none"/>{[0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315].map(a=>{const rad=a*Math.PI/180,x=40+28*Math.sin(rad),y=40-28*Math.cos(rad);return <circle key={a} cx={x} cy={y} r="1.5" fill={g} opacity=".4"/>})}</svg>;
  if (cat==="Pulseiras") return <svg width={size} height={size*.6} viewBox="0 0 80 50"><ellipse cx="40" cy="25" rx="32" ry="16" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" opacity=".6"/><ellipse cx="40" cy="25" rx="32" ry="16" stroke={g} strokeWidth="4" fill="none" opacity=".07"/>{[0,60,120,180,240,300].map(a=>{const rad=a*Math.PI/180,x=40+32*Math.cos(rad),y=25+16*Math.sin(rad);return <circle key={a} cx={x} cy={y} r="2" fill={g} opacity=".5"/>})}</svg>;
  if (cat==="Anéis") return <svg width={size*.7} height={size*.7} viewBox="0 0 56 56"><circle cx="28" cy="28" r="20" stroke={g} strokeWidth="5" fill="none" opacity=".12"/><circle cx="28" cy="28" r="20" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" opacity=".7"/><polygon points="28,8 32,20 28,17 24,20" fill={g} opacity=".6"/></svg>;
  return <svg width={size*.55} height={size} viewBox="0 0 44 80"><circle cx="22" cy="11" r="6" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" opacity=".7"/><circle cx="22" cy="11" r="2.5" fill={g} opacity=".4"/><line x1="22" y1="17" x2="22" y2="32" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1.2" opacity=".5"/><polygon points="14,32 30,32 34,52 22,62 10,52" stroke={g} strokeWidth="1" fill="none" opacity=".6"/></svg>;
};

export default function ZahirStore() {
  const [page,setPage]           = useState("home");
  const [activeCat,setActiveCat] = useState("Todos");
  const [cart,setCart]           = useState([]);
  const [cartOpen,setCartOpen]   = useState(false);
  const [featured,setFeatured]   = useState(null);
  const [sit,setSit]             = useState(null);
  const [detail,setDetail]       = useState("");
  const [aiState,setAiState]     = useState("idle");
  const [aiResult,setAiResult]   = useState(null);
  const [loadMsg,setLoadMsg]     = useState("");
  const [added,setAdded]         = useState(null);
  const [done,setDone]           = useState(false);
  const [form,setForm]           = useState({name:"",email:"",addr:""});
  const [scrolled,setScrolled]   = useState(false);

  useEffect(()=>{
    const link=document.createElement("link");
    link.rel="stylesheet";
    link.href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@200;300;400;500&display=swap";
    document.head.appendChild(link);
    const fn=()=>setScrolled(window.scrollY>40);
    window.addEventListener("scroll",fn);
    return ()=>window.removeEventListener("scroll",fn);
  },[]);

  const addToCart = p => {
    setCart(c=>{const ex=c.find(i=>i.id===p.id);return ex?c.map(i=>i.id===p.id?{...i,qty:i.qty+1}:i):[...c,{...p,qty:1}];});
    setAdded(p.id); setTimeout(()=>setAdded(null),2000);
    setCartOpen(true);
  };
  const removeFromCart = id => setCart(c=>c.filter(i=>i.id!==id));
  const cartTotal = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
  const cartCount = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);
  const filtered  = activeCat==="Todos"?PRODUCTS:PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.cat===activeCat);
  const bg = (url,br=.5) => ({backgroundImage:`url(${url})`,backgroundSize:"cover",backgroundPosition:"center",filter:`brightness(${br}) saturate(1.15)`});

  async function getAI() {
    if (!sit) return;
    setAiState("loading"); setAiResult(null);
    const msgs=["A ler a tua energia...","A perceber o que precisas...","A encontrar a peça certa...","Quase pronto..."];
    let i=0; setLoadMsg(msgs[0]);
    const iv=setInterval(()=>{i=(i+1)%msgs.length;setLoadMsg(msgs[i]);},1900);
    const s=SITS.find(x=>x.id===sit);
    const prompt=`És consultora de estilo da marca ZAHIR — bijuteria em aço inoxidável com poderes intencionais, portuguesa e de luxo acessível.
A cliente prepara-se para: "${s.l}" (${s.s}).${detail?`\nDetalhe adicional: "${detail}"`:""}
CATÁLOGO COMPLETO:\n${CATALOG_TEXT}
Analisa o momento e escolhe a peça PERFEITA. Responde APENAS com JSON válido sem markdown:
{"peca":"nome exato da peça","categoria":"Colares|Pulseiras|Anéis|Brincos","tagline":"tagline exata","poder":"poder exato","porque":"2 frases elegantes em português explicando por que esta peça é perfeita para este momento específico","mensagem":"1 frase poderosa e pessoal, como uma amiga íntima que te conhece — em português"}`;
    try {
      const res=await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({model:"claude-sonnet-4-20250514",max_tokens:600,messages:[{role:"user",content:prompt}]})});
      const data=await res.json();
      const parsed=JSON.parse(data.content?.[0]?.text.replace(/```json|```/g,"").trim());
      clearInterval(iv); setAiResult(parsed); setAiState("result");
    } catch{clearInterval(iv);setAiState("idle");}
  }

  return (
    <div style={{fontFamily:sans,background:C.cream,color:C.dark,minHeight:"100vh"}}>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
        @keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
        @keyframes slideIn{from{transform:translateX(100%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
        .fu{animation:fadeUp .65s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
        .card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 56px rgba(26,15,6,.13)!important}
        .gb:hover{opacity:.82}
        .nl:hover{color:${C.gold}!important}
        .sit:hover{background:rgba(184,137,42,.05)!important;border-left-color:rgba(184,137,42,.4)!important}
        *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:${C.gold}}
      `}</style>

      {/* ── NAV ── */}
      <nav style={{position:"fixed",top:0,left:0,right:0,zIndex:200,background:page==="home"&&!scrolled?"rgba(0,0,0,.18)":"rgba(250,245,238,.97)",backdropFilter:"blur(16px)",borderBottom:page==="home"&&!scrolled?"none":`1px solid ${C.border}`,transition:"all .4s",padding:"0 5vw",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",height:68}}>
        <span onClick={()=>setPage("home")} style={{fontFamily:f,fontSize:26,fontWeight:600,letterSpacing:8,cursor:"pointer",color:page==="home"&&!scrolled?"#faf5ee":C.dark,transition:"color .4s"}}>ZAHIR</span>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:28,alignItems:"center"}}>
          {[["Início","home"],["Loja","shop"],["Descobre","ai"],["A Marca","about"]].map(([l,p])=>(
            <span key={p} className="nl" onClick={()=>setPage(p)} style={{fontSize:10,letterSpacing:3,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",color:page===p?C.gold:page==="home"&&!scrolled?"rgba(250,245,238,.8)":C.muted,transition:"color .3s",fontWeight:300}}>{l}</span>
          ))}
          <button onClick={()=>setCartOpen(true)} style={{background:"transparent",color:page==="home"&&!scrolled?"#faf5ee":C.dark,border:`1px solid ${page==="home"&&!scrolled?"rgba(250,245,238,.35)":"rgba(26,15,6,.18)"}`,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,fontWeight:300,transition:"all .3s"}}>
            <CartIcon size={17} color={page==="home"&&!scrolled?"#faf5ee":C.dark}/>
            <span style={{textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:2,fontSize:10}}>Carrinho</span>
            {cartCount>0 && <span style={{background:C.gold,color:"#fff",borderRadius:"50%",width:18,height:18,fontSize:9,display:"inline-flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:600}}>{cartCount}</span>}
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {/* ── CART SIDEBAR ── */}
      {cartOpen && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,zIndex:300}}>
          <div onClick={()=>setCartOpen(false)} style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,background:"rgba(26,15,6,.55)",backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}/>
          <div style={{position:"absolute",top:0,right:0,bottom:0,width:400,background:C.cream,animation:"slideIn .35s ease",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column"}}>
            <div style={{padding:"26px 28px 20px",borderBottom:`1px solid ${C.border}`,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
              <span style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:22}}>O teu carrinho</span>
              <span onClick={()=>setCartOpen(false)} style={{cursor:"pointer",fontSize:24,color:C.muted,lineHeight:1}}>×</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{flex:1,overflowY:"auto",padding:"18px 28px"}}>
              {cart.length===0 ? (
                <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:"64px 0",color:C.muted}}>
                  <CartIcon size={36} color={C.border}/>
                  <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:19,marginTop:16,marginBottom:8}}>O teu carrinho está vazio</p>
                  <p style={{fontSize:11,letterSpacing:2,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>Descobre as nossas peças</p>
                </div>
              ) : cart.map(item=>(
                <div key={item.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:14,alignItems:"center",paddingBottom:18,marginBottom:18,borderBottom:`1px solid ${C.border}`}}>
                  <div style={{width:54,height:54,background:C.warm,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",flexShrink:0}}><JewelArt cat={item.cat} size={34}/></div>
                  <div style={{flex:1}}>
                    <div style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:18}}>{item.name}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:C.muted,letterSpacing:1}}>{item.cat} · Qty {item.qty}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{textAlign:"right"}}>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:500,fontSize:15,marginBottom:4}}>{(item.price*item.qty).toFixed(2)}€</div>
                    <span onClick={()=>removeFromCart(item.id)} style={{fontSize:10,color:C.muted,cursor:"pointer",letterSpacing:1,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>remover</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {cart.length>0 && (
              <div style={{padding:"20px 28px",borderTop:`1px solid ${C.border}`}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:20}}>
                  <span style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:19}}>Total</span>
                  <span style={{fontFamily:f,fontSize:24,fontWeight:600}}>{cartTotal.toFixed(2)}€</span>
                </div>
                <button className="gb" onClick={()=>{setCartOpen(false);setPage("checkout");}} style={{width:"100%",background:C.dark,color:C.cream,border:"none",padding:"15px",fontSize:11,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,transition:"opacity .3s",fontWeight:400}}>
                  Finalizar Encomenda
                </button>
                <button className="gb" onClick={()=>setCartOpen(false)} style={{width:"100%",background:"transparent",color:C.muted,border:"none",padding:"12px",fontSize:11,letterSpacing:3,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,marginTop:8,fontWeight:300}}>
                  Continuar a Explorar
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── HOME ── */}
      {page==="home" && (
        <div>
          {/* Hero — fotos reais */}
          <section style={{minHeight:"100vh",position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center"}}>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,...bg(IMG_HERO,.52)}}/>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,background:"linear-gradient(170deg,rgba(26,15,6,.15) 0%,rgba(26,15,6,.7) 100%)"}}/>
            <div className="fu" style={{textAlign:"center",position:"relative",zIndex:2,padding:"0 24px"}}>
              <p style={{fontSize:10,letterSpacing:7,textTransform:"uppercase",color:"rgba(250,225,160,.85)",marginBottom:28,fontWeight:300}}>Bijuteria em Aço Inoxidável · Portugal</p>
              <h1 style={{fontFamily:f,fontSize:"clamp(80px,16vw,160px)",fontWeight:300,color:"#faf5ee",letterSpacing:14,lineHeight:.92,marginBottom:32}}>ZAHIR</h1>
              <div style={{width:60,height:1,background:"rgba(184,137,42,.9)",margin:"0 auto 28px"}}/>
              <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:"clamp(17px,2.5vw,26px)",color:"rgba(250,245,238,.8)",marginBottom:56,fontWeight:300,letterSpacing:.5}}>
                Made to stand out. Impossible to ignore.
              </p>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:14,justifyContent:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                <button className="gb" onClick={()=>setPage("shop")} style={{background:C.gold,color:C.cream,border:"none",padding:"16px 44px",fontSize:10,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,fontWeight:400,transition:"opacity .3s"}}>
                  Ver Coleção
                </button>
                <button className="gb" onClick={()=>setPage("ai")} style={{background:"transparent",color:"rgba(250,245,238,.88)",border:"1px solid rgba(250,245,238,.35)",padding:"16px 44px",fontSize:10,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,fontWeight:300}}>
                  Descobre a Tua Peça
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div onClick={()=>setPage("shop")} style={{position:"absolute",bottom:36,left:"50%",transform:"translateX(-50%)",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",gap:10,cursor:"pointer"}}>
              <div style={{width:1,height:48,background:"linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(184,137,42,.7))"}}/>
              <span style={{fontSize:9,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",color:"rgba(250,245,238,.35)"}}>colecção</span>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* Editorial strip — "Feita para durar" */}
          <section style={{position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",minHeight:520,display:"flex",alignItems:"center"}}>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,...bg(IMG_GOLD,.42)}}/>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,background:"linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(26,15,6,.88) 40%,rgba(26,15,6,.15) 100%)"}}/>
            <div style={{position:"relative",zIndex:1,padding:"80px 8vw",maxWidth:580}}>
              <p style={{fontSize:10,letterSpacing:5,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.gold,marginBottom:20,fontWeight:300}}>A Coleção</p>
              <h2 style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:"clamp(32px,5vw,54px)",fontWeight:300,color:C.cream,lineHeight:1.1,marginBottom:28}}>
                36 peças.<br/>Uma para cada<br/>versão de ti.
              </h2>
              <div style={{width:44,height:1,background:C.gold,marginBottom:28}}/>
              <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:17,color:"rgba(250,245,238,.58)",lineHeight:1.85,marginBottom:36}}>
                Cada peça Zahir tem um nome, uma história e um poder que escolhes activar. Bijuteria em aço inoxidável premium — resistente à água, ao tempo e ao olhar dos outros.
              </p>
              <button className="gb" onClick={()=>setPage("shop")} style={{background:C.gold,color:C.cream,border:"none",padding:"14px 38px",fontSize:10,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,fontWeight:400,transition:"opacity .3s"}}>
                Explorar Agora
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* Manifesto */}

            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,...bg(IMG_POWER,.28)}}/>

              <p style={{fontSize:10,letterSpacing:6,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.gold,marginBottom:24,fontWeight:300}}>O manifesto Zahir</p>

                Zahir pieces are made for those who carry<br/>

                Because power isn't shown. It's felt."
              </p>
              <div style={{width:44,height:1,background:C.gold,margin:"0 auto 32px"}}/>

                Conhecer a Marca
              </button>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── SHOP ── */}

            <span style={{fontSize:11,letterSpacing:2,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.dark,fontWeight:400}}>Loja</span>

        <div style={{position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",height:260}}>

            </p>

                    </div>

                    <button className="gb" onClick={getAI} style={{background:C.dark,color:C.cream,border:"none",padding:"15px 42px",fontSize:10,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,fontWeight:400,transition:"opacity .3s"}}>
                      Encontrar a Minha Peça ✦
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {aiState==="loading" && (
                  <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:"52px 0"}}>
                    <div style={{width:38,height:38,border:`1px solid ${C.border}`,borderTop:`1px solid ${C.gold}`,borderRadius:"50%",animation:"spin 1.4s linear infinite",margin:"0 auto 20px"}}/>
                    <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:18,color:C.muted}}>{loadMsg}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
            {aiState==="result" && aiResult && (
              <div className="fu">
                <div style={{background:C.dark,padding:"48px 40px",position:"relative",overflow:"hidden"}}>
                  <div style={{position:"absolute",top:0,left:0,right:0,height:2,background:`linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,${C.gold},transparent)`}}/>
                  <div style={{position:"absolute",bottom:0,right:0,width:180,height:180,backgroundImage:`url(${featured?.cat==="Colares"?IMG_GOLD:IMG_POWER})`,backgroundSize:"cover",opacity:.08}}/>

                    Outro Momento
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── ABOUT ── */}
      {page==="about" && (
        <div style={{paddingTop:68}}>
          <div style={{padding:"16px 5vw",borderBottom:`1px solid ${C.border}`,display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
            <span onClick={()=>setPage("home")} style={{fontSize:11,letterSpacing:2,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.muted,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:300}}>Início</span>
            <span style={{color:C.border,fontSize:11}}>/</span>
            <span style={{fontSize:11,letterSpacing:2,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.dark,fontWeight:400}}>A Marca</span>

        <div style={{position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",minHeight:500,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",textAlign:"center"}}>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,...bg(IMG_POWER,.28)}}/>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,background:"rgba(26,15,6,.6)"}}/>
            <div style={{position:"relative",zIndex:1,padding:"80px 24px",maxWidth:660,margin:"0 auto"}}>
              <h1 style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:"clamp(52px,10vw,96px)",fontWeight:300,color:C.cream,letterSpacing:8,lineHeight:.95,marginBottom:24}}>ZAHIR</h1>
              <div style={{width:44,height:1,background:C.gold,margin:"0 auto 24px"}}/>
              <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:"clamp(16px,2.5vw,22px)",color:"rgba(250,245,238,.65)",lineHeight:1.7}}>
                Em árabe, Zahir significa "o que é visível, o que se manifesta." O detalhe que captura a atenção — e fica.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{padding:"80px 5vw",maxWidth:900,margin:"0 auto",display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:64}}>

              <h2 style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:36,fontWeight:300,marginBottom:18}}>A nossa filosofia</h2>
              <div style={{width:36,height:1,background:C.gold,marginBottom:24}}/>
              <p style={{fontSize:15,color:C.muted,lineHeight:1.9,fontWeight:300,marginBottom:18}}>
                Zahir não é apenas bijuteria. É uma intenção que usas no corpo — um lembrete do teu poder, todos os dias. Cada peça foi criada para ser sentida antes de ser vista.
              </p>
              <p style={{fontSize:15,color:C.muted,lineHeight:1.9,fontWeight:300}}>
                Produzida em aço inoxidável 316L premium, a Zahir é hipoalergénica, resistente à água e ao uso diário. Feita para durar — como a mulher que a usa.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:26}}>

                ["I","Intenção","Cada peça tem um nome e um poder específico. Não usas por acaso — usas com propósito."],
                ["II","Qualidade","Aço inoxidável 316L premium. Hipoalergénico. Resistente à água, ao suor e ao tempo."],
                ["III","Identidade","36 nomes. 36 poderes. Colares, pulseiras, anéis e brincos — uma peça para cada versão de ti."],
                ["IV","Origem","Uma marca portuguesa criada com alma. Para mulheres que não precisam de pedir desculpa por brilhar."],
              ].map(([ic,t,d])=>(
                <div key={t} style={{display:"flex",gap:20,alignItems:"flex-start",paddingBottom:20,borderBottom:`1px solid ${C.border}`}}>
                  <div style={{flexShrink:0,width:36,height:36,border:`1px solid ${C.gold}`,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",marginTop:2}}>
                    <span style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:13,color:C.gold,letterSpacing:1}}>{ic}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:20,marginBottom:6,color:C.dark}}>{t}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:13,color:C.muted,lineHeight:1.8,fontWeight:300}}>{d}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{position:"relative",overflow:"hidden",minHeight:280,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",textAlign:"center"}}>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,...bg(IMG_GOLD,.35)}}/>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,background:"rgba(26,15,6,.65)"}}/>
            <div style={{position:"relative",zIndex:1,padding:"60px 24px"}}>
              <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:"clamp(20px,3vw,30px)",color:"rgba(250,245,238,.7)",marginBottom:24,maxWidth:540,margin:"0 auto 24px"}}>
                "Made to be seen. Made to be felt."
              </p>
              <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"rgba(250,245,238,.4)",letterSpacing:2,marginTop:20}}>
                +351 912 251 686 · zahirbysonia@gmail.com
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── CHECKOUT ── */}
      {page==="checkout" && (
        <div style={{paddingTop:0,minHeight:"100vh",padding:"100px 5vw 80px",maxWidth:580,margin:"0 auto"}}>
          {!done ? (
            <>
              <p style={{fontSize:10,letterSpacing:5,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.gold,marginBottom:12,fontWeight:300}}>Encomenda</p>
              <h1 style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:40,fontWeight:300,marginBottom:32}}>Finalizar Compra</h1>
              <div style={{marginBottom:28}}>
                {cart.map(i=>(
                  <div key={i.id} style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",padding:"12px 0",borderBottom:`1px solid ${C.border}`,fontSize:14}}>
                    <span style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic"}}>{i.name} <span style={{fontFamily:sans,fontSize:11,color:C.muted}}>×{i.qty}</span></span>
                    <span style={{fontFamily:f,fontSize:16}}>{(i.price*i.qty).toFixed(2)}€</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",padding:"16px 0 0",fontFamily:f,fontSize:24}}>
                  <span style={{fontStyle:"italic"}}>Total</span>
                  <span style={{fontWeight:600}}>{cartTotal.toFixed(2)}€</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              {[["Nome completo","name","text"],["Email","email","email"],["Morada de entrega","addr","text"]].map(([l,k,t])=>(
                <div key={k} style={{marginBottom:16}}>
                  <label style={{display:"block",fontSize:10,letterSpacing:3,textTransform:"uppercase",color:C.muted,marginBottom:8,fontWeight:300}}>{l}</label>
                  <input type={t} value={form[k]} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,[k]:e.target.value}))} style={{width:"100%",background:"#fff",border:`1px solid ${C.border}`,padding:"13px 15px",fontSize:14,fontFamily:sans,outline:"none",fontWeight:300,color:C.dark}}/>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div style={{background:C.warm,padding:"16px 20px",marginBottom:28,fontSize:13,color:C.muted,lineHeight:1.8,fontWeight:300,borderLeft:`3px solid ${C.gold}`}}>

                <strong style={{color:C.dark,fontWeight:400}}>Envio para todo Portugal · Portes a combinar.</strong>
              </div>
              <button className="gb" onClick={()=>{if(form.name&&form.email){setDone(true);setCart([]);}}} style={{width:"100%",background:C.dark,color:C.cream,border:"none",padding:"16px",fontSize:11,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,fontWeight:400,transition:"opacity .3s"}}>
                Confirmar Encomenda
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="fu" style={{textAlign:"center",padding:"100px 0"}}>
              <div style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:56,color:C.gold,marginBottom:20}}>✦</div>
              <h2 style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:36,fontWeight:300,marginBottom:16}}>Obrigada, {form.name}.</h2>
              <p style={{fontSize:15,color:C.muted,lineHeight:1.9,maxWidth:380,margin:"0 auto 36px",fontWeight:300}}>A tua encomenda foi recebida. Entraremos em contacto em breve para confirmar todos os detalhes.</p>
              <button className="gb" onClick={()=>{setPage("home");setDone(false);setForm({name:"",email:"",addr:"",});}} style={{background:C.dark,color:C.cream,border:"none",padding:"14px 36px",fontSize:10,letterSpacing:4,textTransform:"uppercase",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:sans,fontWeight:400,transition:"opacity .3s"}}>
                Continuar a Explorar
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── FOOTER ── */}
      {page!=="checkout" && (
        <footer style={{background:"#0e0805",padding:"52px 5vw",textAlign:"center",borderTop:"1px solid rgba(184,137,42,.1)"}}>
          <h2 style={{fontFamily:f,fontSize:34,fontWeight:300,color:C.cream,letterSpacing:12,marginBottom:12}}>ZAHIR</h2>
          <p style={{fontFamily:f,fontStyle:"italic",fontSize:14,color:"rgba(250,245,238,.3)",marginBottom:20,letterSpacing:1}}>Made to stand out. Impossible to ignore.</p>
          <div style={{width:36,height:1,background:"rgba(184,137,42,.25)",margin:"0 auto 20px"}}/>
          <p style={{fontSize:12,color:"rgba(250,245,238,.2)",letterSpacing:2,fontWeight:300}}>+351 912 251 686 · zahirbysonia@gmail.com</p>
          <p style={{fontSize:10,color:"rgba(250,245,238,.12)",letterSpacing:2,fontWeight:300,marginTop:12}}>© 2026 Zahir Portugal · Bijuteria em Aço Inoxidável</p>
        </footer>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
